description:
Every later child asserts against the PUBLIC trace. There is no helper that
captures it in-process, so the first child cannot write its own red test.

`JsonlBackend::new_public_writer` (`jsonl.rs:736`) already applies the exact
production allowlist (`is_public_compiler2_trace_event`) and is exercised today
only by two writer-ERROR tests (`jsonl_test.rs:88`, `:163`) -- nothing captures
content. `capture::vec_writer` supplies the sink. No subprocess, no temp file.

## Deliver

- A helper that compiles a source and returns the parsed public event stream,
  in emission order.
- Query surface the later children need: events by name, spans paired by
  `span_id`, metadata by key, parent/child span nesting.
- It reads ONLY the public allowlisted trace. A helper that peeks at a
  non-public event defeats the point of every acceptance check built on it.

## Red test

A two-formula fact chain: one changed fact and one unchanged conclusion produce
an exact, ordered causal trace. (Ticket TDD 1, at harness level.)

## Checks

- The helper is used by its own test, not just defined.
- No production code changes.
title: Public-log content capture helper for tests
